corrected_content.problem: Which of the following is equivalent to the line integral of the function $f(x, y, z) = x + y + z$, traversed along the line segment from $(1, 0, 1)$ to $(2, 3, 0)$?
corrected_content.worked_solution:
Parametrize the segment by

$$
r(t)=\langle1+t,3t,1-t\rangle,\qquad0\le t\le1.
$$

The speed is $|r'(t)|=\sqrt{1+9+1}=\sqrt{11}$, and $f(r(t))=2+3t$. Thus

$$
\int_C f\,ds=\sqrt{11}\int_0^1(2+3t)\,dt.
$$
